privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes the data processed by the AVYOR mobile app and by this presentation site. It is written from how the product actually works. The publisher’s identification details, the exact retention periods and the transfer safeguards are still to be completed before going live: they are flagged as such rather than estimated.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.body: AVYOR is a mobile app that connects Creators and brands so they can discover profiles, publish campaigns and run content collaborations. The product is operated by Shavod.
sections.todo: The publisher’s registered name, legal form, share capital, company registration number, VAT number and registered address.

sections.title: 2. Scope
sections.body: This policy covers two distinct perimeters: the AVYOR mobile app, which is built around a user account, and the presentation site you are reading, which has none. The processing that applies to each is described separately below.

sections.title: 3. This presentation site
sections.body: This site is hosted by Vercel and has neither an account form nor any advertising tool. It measures its traffic with Vercel Web Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights, two cookieless tools: no cookie is placed on your device and no lasting identifier is assigned to you. What is recorded is the page viewed, the page that led you there, the country, the device type, the operating system and the browser, along with measurements of how fast the page displays. That data is only used to understand the site’s audience and to fix what is slow; it cannot follow you from one site to another and it is neither sold nor cross-referenced with your account. A preference stored in your browser’s session memory means the intro animation only plays once; it disappears when the tab is closed and never leaves your device. Messages you send to the contact address are processed in order to answer your request.
sections.todo: Legal basis for audience measurement to be decided: consent exemption for audience measurement, or legitimate interest, depending on the analysis retained against the CNIL criteria. Vercel’s registered name and address to be taken from its own legal notice.

sections.title: 4. Data you provide to us
sections.body: In the app, this data comes directly from you:
items: Account: email address and password, through Supabase authentication.
Profile: name, photo, biography, links to your social networks.
Content: videos, portfolio items, campaign applications.
Campaigns: brief, expected content and terms, for a brand account.
Messages: conversations and collaboration requests.

sections.title: 5. Data generated by use
sections.body: Using the app produces data you do not type in: views, likes and interactions with content and campaigns, how far collaborations and deliverables have progressed, and the information brought together by matching between a profile and a campaign.

sections.title: 6. Technical data
sections.body: Running the service produces technical data: connection and security logs tied to authentication, and error reports sent to Sentry when an incident occurs. Usage measurement for the app goes through PostHog.
sections.todo: Precise list of the events sent to PostHog and the retention period configured with each processor.

sections.title: 7. Why we use your data
sections.body: This data is used to provide the connection between Creators and brands, to secure your account, to run campaigns, messaging and collaboration tracking, to process payments, to send the notifications tied to your activity, and to fix technical faults.

sections.title: 8. Legal bases
sections.body: Processing rests on performance of the contract between you and AVYOR for providing the service, on AVYOR’s legitimate interest in security and product improvement, on a legal obligation for anything relating to invoicing and fraud prevention, and on your consent where it is collected, in particular for non-essential notifications.

sections.title: 9. Profiles and visibility
sections.body: Your profile, your videos and your portfolio are meant to be seen by other AVYOR users: that is the very function of the product. What you publish there should be chosen accordingly. Your messages, by contrast, are only visible to the people they are addressed to.

sections.title: 10. Campaigns and collaborations
sections.body: When a collaboration begins, the information needed to carry it out is shared between the Creator and the brand concerned: the profile’s identity, the campaign content, the exchanges and the deliverables. Matching brings together profile information and campaign information to suggest relevant profiles; the final decision always belongs to the brand.

sections.title: 11. Messaging
sections.body: Conversations are kept so that a project’s context stays available during and after the collaboration. They may be read by our teams when handling a report or a dispute, and for that reason alone.

sections.title: 12. Payments
sections.body: Payments between brands and Creators go through Stripe. AVYOR stores no card data. Billing and payment account information is processed by Stripe as a controller for what falls under its own regulatory obligations.

sections.title: 13. Notifications
sections.body: Notifications tell you about the activity that concerns you: a new message, a change to an application, a stage in a collaboration. They are configured from the app’s settings.

sections.title: 14. Cookies and similar technologies
sections.body: This site uses no cookies, including for audience measurement: Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights work without placing any. The mobile app relies on local storage needed to keep your session and your preferences; it is not used for advertising.

sections.title: 15. Processors and service providers
sections.body: AVYOR relies on a limited number of technical providers:
items: Vercel — hosting of this site, audience measurement and speed measurement.
Supabase — data hosting and authentication.
Stripe — payment and transfer processing.
PostHog — product usage measurement.
Sentry — technical error monitoring.
sections.todo: Server locations retained with each provider and references of the signed data processing agreements.

sections.title: 16. Data sharing
sections.body: AVYOR does not sell your personal data and passes it to no data broker. Sharing is limited to the providers listed above, to the users you choose to interact with, and to the competent authorities where a legal obligation requires it.

sections.title: 17. Transfers outside the European Union
sections.body: Some of the providers named may process data outside the European Union. That is notably the case for Vercel, a company established in the United States, which hosts this site and measures its audience.
sections.todo: Hosting regions actually retained and the applicable transfer mechanism for each provider, to be documented before going live.

sections.title: 18. Retention periods
sections.body: Your data is kept for as long as your account is active. After the account is deleted, the records needed to meet legal obligations, in particular accounting ones, are kept for the required time and then deleted.
sections.todo: Exact periods per category of data, to be set with the publisher before publication: they are not estimated here.

sections.title: 19. Security
sections.body: Exchanges with the service are encrypted with HTTPS/TLS. Authentication and sensitive account changes go through Supabase’s authentication system. No system is infallible: never share your password, and tell us about any unusual activity on your account.

sections.title: 20. Your rights
sections.body: If the General Data Protection Regulation applies to you, you have the following rights over your personal data:
items: Access: obtain confirmation that your data is processed and receive a copy of it.
Rectification: have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected.
Erasure: ask for your data to be deleted, within the limits set by law.
Restriction: ask for processing to be frozen while something is checked.
Objection: object to processing based on legitimate interest.
Portability: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Withdrawal of consent: withdraw it at any time, without affecting what came before.

sections.title: 21. Exercising your rights
sections.body: Write to the contact address given at the end of this document, stating the email address linked to your account and the nature of your request. Do not attach passwords or full bank details.
sections.todo: Appointment of a data protection officer and publication of their contact details, if such an appointment is required.

sections.title: 22. Deleting my account
sections.body: Deletion happens from the app: open Settings, then Security, and choose to delete your account. Your profile, your content and your conversations then stop being accessible to other users. If a collaboration is under way, finish it or contact support before deleting your account: records tied to a payment may have to be kept for legal reasons. If you run into difficulty, write to the contact address from the email linked to the account.

sections.title: 23. Minors
sections.body: AVYOR is not intended for children. If we learn that an account has been created below the required age, it is deleted.
sections.todo: Minimum age retained for opening an account, to be aligned with the terms of use and the applicable law.

sections.title: 24. Changes to this policy
sections.body: This policy may change along with the product. The date it was last updated appears at the top of the page, and any substantial change will be flagged to you in the app.

sections.title: 25. Contacting us
sections.body: For any question about this policy or about your data, write to us at the contact address below.

sections.title: 26. Supervisory authority
sections.body: If you believe your rights are not being respected, you may lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority. In France, that is the Commission nationale de l’informatique et des libertés (CNIL), www.cnil.fr.
sections.todo: Lead authority to be confirmed once the publisher’s main establishment is settled.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the AVYOR app and collaborations between Creators and brands. They describe how the product actually works. The publisher’s identity, the applicable law and the competent courts are still to be settled before going live and are flagged as such.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
sections.body: These terms set the rules for accessing and using AVYOR, a mobile app connecting Creators and brands. By creating an account or using the app, you accept them, along with the privacy policy. If you do not accept them, do not use AVYOR.

sections.title: 2. Definitions
sections.body: For the reading of this document:
items: Creator: a user who presents their work and answers campaigns.
Brand: a user who publishes a campaign and looks for Creators.
Campaign: a brief published by a brand, describing the project, the expected content and the terms.
Collaboration: a project engaged between a Creator and a brand following a campaign.
Deliverable: content handed over by the Creator as part of a collaboration.

sections.title: 3. Access to the service
sections.body: AVYOR is accessed from a mobile app. Access requires a compatible device and an internet connection, the cost of which remains yours. Some features may change, be added or be removed as the product moves forward.

sections.title: 4. Creating an account
sections.body: You provide accurate information when creating your account and keep it up to date. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for the actions taken from your account. An account is personal: it is neither shared nor transferred.

sections.title: 5. Age requirements
sections.body: AVYOR is reserved for people who have reached the age required to enter into a contract and to consent to the processing of their data.
sections.todo: Minimum age retained, to be aligned with the privacy policy and the applicable law.

sections.title: 6. User obligations
sections.body: You undertake to use AVYOR in accordance with the law and with these terms, not to impersonate anyone, not to publish content you do not hold the rights to, and not to attempt to bypass the technical mechanisms of the service.

sections.title: 7. Creator profiles
sections.body: Your profile, your videos and your portfolio are meant to be seen by other users. They must reflect your actual work. The statistics shown describe the activity observed on your content; they are neither a promise of reach nor a guarantee of income.

sections.title: 8. Brand accounts
sections.body: If you use AVYOR on behalf of an organisation, you declare that you have the authority to bind it. The campaign information published must be accurate and reflect the project actually intended.

sections.title: 9. Campaigns
sections.body: A campaign describes the project, the expected content and the terms of the collaboration. Those elements are the shared reference for the project: a brand cannot later demand a deliverable outside the brief that was accepted.

sections.title: 10. Applications and matching
sections.body: A Creator can apply to a campaign; a brand can read profiles and the compatibility information offered by matching. Matching is a reading aid: it does not decide, and neither AVYOR nor matching guarantees that an application will succeed.

sections.title: 11. Collaborations
sections.body: A collaboration begins when the Creator and the brand agree on a campaign. Exchanges, stages and deliverables are followed in the app. AVYOR provides the tool; the agreement binds the Creator and the brand to each other.

sections.title: 12. Content
sections.body: You remain the owner of the content you publish on AVYOR. By publishing it, you grant AVYOR a limited, non-exclusive licence, strictly necessary to host it, display it and distribute it within the app as part of running the service.

sections.title: 13. Rights over deliverables
sections.body: The usage rights granted to the brand over a deliverable are those set out in the terms of the campaign that was accepted: medium, duration and territory. Any use beyond that frame requires a separate agreement between the brand and the Creator.

sections.title: 14. AVYOR’s intellectual property
sections.body: The AVYOR name, its logo, its interface and its software components are protected. These terms transfer no right over them to you.

sections.title: 15. Messaging
sections.body: Messaging is there for exchanges tied to campaigns and collaborations. It is not an unlimited private channel: conversations may be read when handling a report or a dispute.

sections.title: 16. Payments
sections.body: Payments go through Stripe; AVYOR stores no banking data. The brand funds the collaboration, and the transfer to the Creator happens after the deliverable is approved, according to the terms of the project and the state of the Creator’s payment account. Amounts and applicable fees are shown in the app before you commit. Processing times depend on the payment provider.

sections.title: 17. Cancellations and collaboration disputes
sections.body: If a collaboration is interrupted, the parties first seek an agreement between themselves. Where disagreement persists, contact support stating which project is concerned. AVYOR is not a party to the agreement made between a Creator and a brand, and does not arbitrate the substance of their contractual relationship in their place.

sections.title: 18. Prohibited behaviour
sections.body: The following, among others, are prohibited:
items: Spam, mass soliciting and audience manipulation.
Harassment, threats and hateful speech.
Violent or unsolicited sexual content.
Fraud, false declarations and impersonation.
Publishing content that infringes a third party’s rights.
Any attempt to bypass the payments provided for by the service.

sections.title: 19. Reporting and moderation
sections.body: Profiles, videos and conversations have reporting and blocking actions. Reports are reviewed and may lead to content being removed or to a measure on the account concerned.

sections.title: 20. Suspension and termination
sections.body: AVYOR may suspend or terminate an account where these terms are breached, in particular after a confirmed report. Where circumstances allow, the measure is preceded by notice and you can contest it with support.

sections.title: 21. Deleting your account
sections.body: You can delete your account at any time from Settings, then Security. Finish any ongoing collaborations first: some records tied to a payment have to be kept for legal reasons, as the privacy policy explains.

sections.title: 22. Liability
sections.body: AVYOR provides a tool for connecting people and is not a party to the agreements made between Creators and brands. AVYOR does not warrant the outcome of a campaign, nor the behaviour of a user. To the extent permitted by applicable law, AVYOR’s liability does not extend to indirect damages. Nothing in this document excludes a liability that cannot be excluded.

sections.title: 23. Service availability
sections.body: AVYOR is provided as is and as available. The service may be interrupted for maintenance, an update or a technical incident. No stated availability level is guaranteed.

sections.title: 24. Third-party services
sections.body: AVYOR relies on third-party services, notably Supabase and Stripe, whose own terms apply to their scope. Links to external services that you may add to your profile are your responsibility.

sections.title: 25. Data protection
sections.body: The processing of your personal data is described in the privacy policy, which forms an integral part of these terms.

sections.title: 26. Changes to these terms
sections.body: These terms may be changed to follow the evolution of the product or of regulations. The date they were last updated appears at the top of the page, and any substantial change will be flagged to you in the app. Continuing to use AVYOR after they take effect counts as acceptance.

sections.title: 27. Applicable law and disputes
sections.body: The conditions under which a dispute relating to these terms is brought before a court depend on the applicable law and on whether you are a consumer or a professional.
sections.todo: Applicable law and competent courts, to be settled with the publisher before going live. No clause is presumed here.

sections.title: 28. Contact
sections.body: For any question about these terms, write to us at the contact address below.

The screenshots shown on this site display the real screens of the app with demonstration data: the profiles, brands, amounts and statistics they contain are illustrative and are neither testimonials nor client results.

sections.title: 9. Terms of use
sections.body: Use of the app is governed by the terms of use, which describe accounts, campaigns, collaborations, content and payments.
